metaCapiActive.comment: Denormalised: true iff this stage's parent Funnel has metaCapiEnabled=true AND a linked active MetaCapiDataset. Maintained by Funnel/AfterSave/SyncStageCapiActive and MetaCapiDataset/AfterSave/SyncStagesOnIsActiveChange. Drives UI visibility of the Meta Conversions API section on the stage detail layout.
